text: Reversed TrEMBL decoys with one hmmer judge lowered recall at 1% FPR for hmmer.prf (.702 to .600), blast.prf (.612 to .477) and hmmer.seq (.453 to .368). A few strong reversed decoys that only hmmsearch, phmmer and psiblast report set the profile runs' thresholds, each resting on about a dozen slots. Measured 24 September 2026; the report under reports/ that held its figures and tables has since been removed.
